title: Billing, Entitlement & Webhook Reconciliation

reconciliation_rules.idempotency: an event id is consumed exactly once; duplicate delivery is recorded as deduped and never replays an effect
reconciliation_rules.signature: events without signature_status VERIFIED are rejected and fail the reconciliation
reconciliation_rules.event_order: events are applied by provider sequence then occurrence time, so arrival order cannot reorder entitlement
reconciliation_rules.retry: redelivery of a consumed id deduplicates; a delivery whose retry_count exceeds max_retry_count is dead-lettered and fails
reconciliation_rules.grace_period: payment_failed grants active_grace only up to grace_end; after that the entitlement reports lapsed
reconciliation_rules.cancellation: cancel_at_period_end keeps entitlement until period end, otherwise entitlement is revoked at the event timestamp
reconciliation_rules.refund: a refund revokes the entitlement at the refund timestamp
reconciliation_rules.entitlement_consistency: the offline snapshot must equal the reconciled status and entitlement_until; a stale or optimistic snapshot fails

limitations: events and the offline snapshot are synthetic local fixtures; no live billing provider, webhook delivery, or settlement call was made
live provider webhook payload schemas, signature algorithms, replay windows, rate limits, settlement, refunds, dunning and payout behaviour remain externally deferred
hosted CI, credentials, audit trail, billing settlement and publication remain DEFERRED-EXTERNAL
no production secret, API key, or webhook endpoint is present in this manifest
